budget.basis: 1 night, 1 room, 2 adults. The cheapest double or twin shown on the page, total including taxes and fees as displayed, in GBP. Hotels.com (uk.hotels.com) for every property it sells; premierinn.com for Premier Inn and hub by Premier Inn, which do not sell through Hotels.com; the operator's own engine (mews) for a property Hotels.com lists but has no rooms for on any sample night; travelodge.co.uk for a Travelodge that Hotels.com does not list; all.accor.com (public rate, not the member rate) for an Accor hotel Hotels.com does not list. Engine google-hotels (the outer London hotels, 15 Sep 2026): Hotels.com's rate for 2 adults as Google Hotels lists it, read through the Apify Hotels.com Scraper, then Expedia's (the same Expedia Group room at the same price), then the hotel's own site, then Booking.com - the source is recorded for every night. Checked against the browser: The Z Hotel Shoreditch matched the Hotels.com page on all five dates, within £1; New Road Hotel ran £2-£35 above its 14 Sep browser capture a day later, with a median of £138 against £143.
budget.rule: A hotel is budget when its median sampled night is £150 or less (Rob, 14 Sep 2026). Needs 3+ priced nights.

nights.note: Hotels.com showed £446 to £705 for every room on Wed 17 Feb 2027 (captured 14 and again 15 Sep 2026), three times its £132 and £153 on the October Sunday and December Saturday: rates a year out that the hotel has not set yet, not a price anyone pays. Rob found it well under £150 when he checked on 15 Sep 2026.

notPriced.name: The Lime Tree Hotel
notPriced.reason: No one-night stay for 2 adults could be booked on any of the five sample nights, on either channel (14 Sep 2026). Hotels.com: 'can't accommodate 2 guests' on 11 and 17 Oct, 'no rooms available at this property' on 17 Feb, 12 Dec and 17 Apr (captures kept in budget-2026-09-14.json). The operator's own SynXis engine (bookings.limetreehotel.co.uk, titled 'Room Mate Lime Tree - Reservations'): 'check-in/check-out combination is not available' for 11 Oct, 17 Feb and 12 Dec; 'cannot accept departures' on the Sunday after 17 Oct and 17 Apr, i.e. no one-night Saturday stays. For scale only, not a sampled night: the room-matehotels.com calendar showed from-prices of £241-£375 for other October 2026 nights (1, 3, 4, 5, 6 and 12 Oct).

notPriced.name: ibis London Wembley
notPriced.reason: Not taking bookings for any of our 2026 nights (15 Sep 2026). all.accor.com, hotel 3141: "This accommodation is unavailable on our site" for 11 Oct, 24 Oct (the night Rob chose instead of 17 Oct, the eve of the NFL game on 18 Oct) and 12 Dec 2026, with every night from two days before to two days after also "Not available". Hotels.com (ho206152): "Sorry, we aren't taking reservations for this property on our site." Apify returned no Google Hotels details on any date. It was bookable in 2027: public rate from €98.19 on 17 Feb and €268.87 on 17 Apr (Accor showed euros). Two of five nights is not enough for a verdict.
